Olakšice koristi samo vikendom: They use the easier rules only at weekends
Olakšice koristi samo dok je na putu: They use the easier rules only while on the road
Ne mora klanjati farzove: They don’t have to pray the fard prayers
Putnik planira kod prijatelja ostati des: A traveller plans to stay with a friend for ten days. Do they use the traveller’s easier rules?
Putnik namjerava u gradu ostati duže od: A traveller intends to stay in a city for more than fifteen days. When do the traveller’s easier rules stop for them?
Po dolasku u mjesto putovanja: When they arrive at the place they travelled to
Koja se vrsta namaza može klanjati sjede: Which kind of prayer can be prayed sitting if standing is difficult for us?
Šta je bolest u životu vjernika i vjerni: What is illness in the life of a believing man or woman?
Razlog da se namaz potpuno ostavi: A reason to give up Salah completely
Kazna bez izlaza: A punishment with no way out
Da li bolest oslobađa muslimana obaveze: Does illness free a Muslim from the duty of Salah if they are able to pray with the easier rules?
Kako će klanjati bolesnik koji ne može k: How will a sick person pray who cannot pray standing?
Samo će učiti dovu: They will only make a du‘a
Naklanjat će kada ozdravi: They will make it up when they get better
Kako bolesnik koji klanja sjedeći može i: How can a sick person who prays sitting do ruku‘ and sajdah?
Išaretom, s tim da se na sedždi nagne vi: With gestures, bending lower for sajdah than for ruku‘
Kako će bolesnik klanjati ako ne može sj: How will a sick person pray if they cannot sit?
Kako će se bolesnik koji klanja ležeći,: If they can, how will a sick person who prays lying down face the Qiblah?
Okrenut će noge prema Kibli, savijajući: They will point their feet towards the Qiblah, bending them at the knees
Okrenut će leđa prema Kibli: They will turn their back to the Qiblah
Nije važno kako će se okrenuti: It doesn’t matter which way they face
Mora ležati na stomaku: They must lie on their stomach
Kako će bolesnik koji leži obavljati nam: How will a sick person who is lying down do the parts of Salah?
Glavu će uzdignuti kako bi simbolički ob: They will raise their head to do the parts of Salah as a sign
Neće obavljati namaske dijelove: They will not do the parts of Salah
Kako može klanjati bolesnik koji ne može: How can a sick person pray who cannot move any part of their body?
Stojeći uz pomoć druge osobe: Standing with help from another person
Kada bolesnik odgađa namaze da ih naklan: When does a sick person put off prayers to make them up later?
Kad mu se ne klanja: When they don’t feel like praying
Kada mu teško stanje ne dozvoljava klanj: When their serious condition does not let them pray even with the easier rules
Šta će bolesnik učiniti s propuštenim na: What will a sick person do with missed prayers if their serious condition lasts less than one day?
Naklanjat će ih kada bude mogao: They will make them up when they are able
Zamijenit će ih dovom: They will replace them with a du‘a
Šta važi ako teško stanje bolesnika potr: What applies if the sick person’s serious condition lasts longer than one day?
Mora naklanjati dvostruko više namaza: They must make up twice as many prayers
Mora naklanjati samo farz sabaha: They must make up only the Fajr fard
Nije obavezan naklanjati propuštene nama: They do not have to make up the missed prayers
Mora ih sve klanjati istog dana: They must pray them all on the same day
Kakva je obaveza osobe koja je u komi il: What is the duty of a person who is in a coma or unconscious for longer than a day and a night?
Mora naklanjati sve namaze: They must make up all the prayers
Mora naklanjati samo jedan namaz: They must make up only one prayer
Nije dužna naklanjati propuštene namaze: They do not have to make up the missed prayers
Šta ako broj propuštenih namaza osobe u: What if the number of prayers missed by a person in a coma or unconscious is six or more?
Mora ih sve naklanjati: They must make them all up
Nije ih dužna naklanjati: They do not have to make them up
Ko procjenjuje svoje stanje i način klan: Who judges their own condition and how to pray during illness?
Bolesnik će sam procijeniti svoje stanje: The sick person will judge their own condition and pray in the best way their health allows
Drugi klanjači u džamiji: Other people praying in the mosque
